teams.name: The Midnight Mechanics
teams.description: FRC Team 812, The Midnight Mechanics, is based at The Preuss School UC San Diego, a charter school for low-income students, and builds competition robots while introducing first-generation students to engineering through hands-on experience with CAD, motor controllers, and version control. The team is known for developing sophisticated robots with advanced features like 360° vision-guided shooters and omnidirectional swerve drivetrains, and they share their robot code and custom tools openly on GitHub.

teams.name: Σ-Motion
teams.description: FRC Team 2658 Σ-Motion is a student-run high school robotics team at Rancho Bernardo High School founded in 2008, dedicated to promoting STEM education and FIRST values through robotics competition. teams.name: Vikings Robotics

The team's mission is to build real-world STEM skills and inspire young people through a six-week annual design and build competition.

teams.name: Inspiration

teams.name: The Clueless
teams.description: The Clueless is a FIRST Tech Challenge (FTC) team founded in 2016 with 13 members from 8 middle and high schools across San Diego that has set the world record twice, qualified to the World Championship 6 times, and won the divisional Inspire Award three times. Beyond competing, the team runs community initiatives including Unity Robotics (which has founded 9 new FLL teams), a Global Mentorship Program (matching 40 teams), IGNITE (founding 8 FTC teams in South Africa), and an EV3 donation program (distributing 105+ EV3s to 2,000+ students).
